# `fluxsim explain`

Print the title and operator-facing explanation of one FLX-nnnn code. With --list, print every registered code instead, so the catalog is discoverable without grepping the source.

## Synopsis

```text
fluxsim explain [options] [<code>]
```

## Examples

```bash
# print one code's explanation
fluxsim explain FLX-1001

# list every code
fluxsim explain --list
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `code` (optional) | the FLX-nnnn code to explain (case-insensitive); omit it with --list |

## Options

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--list` |  | print every registered code as `code [family] title` |
| `-j, --json` |  | emit machine-readable JSON |
